# Hydraulic and Pneumatic Products (HPP)

> HPP (Hydraulic and Pneumatic Products) is a Delhi, India-based manufacturer and supplier of hydraulic and pneumatic engineering solutions, serving industrial, manufacturing, construction, mining, agriculture, and energy sectors since 2013. Backed by 30+ skilled professionals, HPP offers custom-built hydraulic power packs, cylinders, oil coolers, presses, and related industrial equipment.

## Company Info
- Founded: 2013
- Managing Director: Prem Kumar Jha
- Team: 30+ skilled professionals
- Location (Registered/Office): Plot No. L-132, Sector-5, DSIIDC Industrial Area, Bawana, New Delhi-110039, India
- Manufacturing Unit: Delhi NCR, India
- Phone: +91-9871456545
- Email: sales2@hppgroup.in
- Clients/Partners: Sona, Jindal, Honda, JK Cement, ISGEC, BHEL, BorgWarner, Endurance, JBM

## Products
- [Hydraulic Power Pack](https://www.aircooledoilcooler.com/hydraulic-power-pack/): Heavy-duty hydraulic power units for industrial applications
- [Hydraulic Cylinder](https://www.aircooledoilcooler.com/hydraulic-cylinder/): Precision hydraulic cylinders
- [Pneumatic Cylinder](https://www.aircooledoilcooler.com/pneumatic-cylinder/): Pneumatic cylinders for automation and industrial use
- [Air Cooled Oil Cooler](https://www.aircooledoilcooler.com/air-cooled-oil-cooler/): Air-cooled oil coolers to prevent hydraulic system overheating
- [Water-Cooled Oil Cooler](https://www.aircooledoilcooler.com/water-cooled-oil-cooler/): Water-cooled oil coolers for high thermal load systems
- [Worm Gear Screw Jack](https://www.aircooledoilcooler.com/worm-gear-screw-jack/): Screw jacks for lifting and positioning applications
- [Industrial Hydraulic Jack](https://www.aircooledoilcooler.com/industrial-hydraulic-jack/): Heavy-duty hydraulic jacks
- [Hydro Tester Machine](https://www.aircooledoilcooler.com/intensifier/): Hydro testing / pressure intensifier equipment
- [Hydraulic Press](https://www.aircooledoilcooler.com/hydraulic-press/): Industrial hydraulic press machines
- [Hydraulic Paper Mill System](https://www.aircooledoilcooler.com/hydraulic-paper-mill-system/): Hydraulic systems for paper mill applications
- [Hydraulic Rotary Unions](https://www.aircooledoilcooler.com/hydraulic-rotary-unions/): Rotary union components for hydraulic systems
